bullets.text: AI Adoption Grows Quietly - **AI** is becoming integral to teams without formal strategies, highlighting the need for shared understanding.
Navigating Renters' Rights - The **Renters’ Rights Act 2025** significantly changes tenancy rules for landlords in England.
AI Tools for Sole Traders - **Sage Copilot** offers free AI solutions to streamline invoicing and reduce admin for sole traders.
Avoiding the AI Pricing Trap - Accountants must rethink pricing strategies to avoid losing value with increased efficiency from **AI**.
From Experimentation to Operation - Accounting firms need to adopt a structured approach to **AI** for effective operational use.
